dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave spline curvature from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute pixel radius forming a sharp point at the highest morphological extremity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin, approximately 75 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex arc forming a bulbous and blunt frontal cranial profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak with low longitudinal extension relative to the melon thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: High obtuse angle, approximately 160 degrees at the junction of the melon and rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive distribution of pale, circular and linear cicatrization/scars across the dorsal and lateral surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive pale mottling pattern covering the majority of the visible torso.
